title: Lafaa fi Samii Gidduu
intro: Lubbuun dhokataan tokko fuula qulqulluu seenaa waaqaa keessatti si eega, mallattoolee fi dinqiiwwan ammallee baroota keessatti sagalee dhageessisan qabattee jirti. Akkuma hordoffii ragaalee hordoftu, seenaa dinqiin mallatteeffame keessa ni deemta — jalqaba dinqii irraa kaasee hanga ol ba’uu samii bira darbee. Hojjetaa eebbifamaa kana ragaa isa dhumaa dura adda baasuu dandeessaa?
clues: Oduu araaraa fi ifaan gara Ilmaan Israa’el ergamaa ta’ee ergame.
Dhaloonni koo mallattoo dinqii ture — abbaa malee gara addunyaa kanaatti dhufe, ajaja isa hundumaa danda’uun.
Kabaja haadha koo himannaa saba ishee irraa falmaa osoon daa'ima ta'ee dubbadhe.
Hayyama Rabbiitiin simbirroota suphee irraa bocee lubbuu itti hafuura baafadhe — ija warra ilaalan duratti balali’anii deeman.
Namoota jaamaa ta’anii dhalatan nan fayyise, nama dhukkuba nadaayiitiin qabame fayyise, warra du’anillee kaase — ta’us dinqiin hundinuu hayyama Rabbiitiin malee kan koo miti.
Gaafa diinonni kiyya na balleessuuf shira xaxan Rabbiin gara samiitti na ol kaasee guyyaa qiyaamaa dura akkan deebi’u waadaa naaf seene.

trial.label: Yeroo Ibsaa
options: Waraana Faraʼoon isa jabaa wajjin wal arge
Gaara sana irratti doonii nan ijaare

outcome.label: Maaltu Ana Ta'e
options: Gara samiitti ol kaafame; akka deebi'u waadaa seene
Qabeenya lafaa gita hin qabne kennameef
Yeroo dheeraaf addaan ba'ee maatii koo waliin deebi'ee walitti makame
outcome.answer: Gara samiitti ol kaafame; akka deebi’u waadaa galeera

arabic: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا عَبْدٌ أَنْعَمْنَا عَلَيْهِ وَجَعَلْنَـٰهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ
verse: He [i.e., Jesus] was not but a servant upon whom We bestowed favor, and We made him an example for the Children of Israel. (43:59)
